notes.title: Update! New control options and improved camera
notes.content:
Hi, in this update we implemented new [b]Gamepad and Keyboard controls and improved camera controls.[/b]

In addition to the current mouse controls, now you have the option to use a gamepad or the keyboard to navigate the menus, build the island, and to freely rotate and move the camera. Try it!

After the release of this game, we developed Island Cities, where we implemented improved gameplay and camera controls using mouse and keyboard. Then, by porting it to Nintendo Switch, we also implemented required gamepad controls.
So, we brought this option to the Island Farmer players on Steam too. Steam Deck players will greatly benefit from it. 
We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Let's play Dolmenjord - Vilking Islands!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/42c6d9a83597a15644ec5ec1dc89ad3c7411956e.png[/img]

Dolmenjord is a game inspired by Norse mythology, where Vikings need help to organize their buildings and villages and thus solve the puzzles and dominate new lands.

It is available now!

Great for Nordic culture fans who love to be challenged with logic puzzles.

Set up each village according to the rules:
- Place all the available houses and walkway pieces.
- Every house must face the walkway.
-  The completed walkway must give access to the port.

The puzzles are simple in the early islands, but it gets challenging as you advance in the exploration. If you prefer a more relaxing journey, that's fine!
Whenever you want, you can enable the Casual Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/0577d939cf97d6c0faadc7f7a473c1082d2151f5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Island Farmer is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/344c38eb4bc78bc1ddf48368fa86f55d7ba57f8f.jpg[/img]

Farms are set up in islands over calm and clear water.
In this tiny fantasy experience, that is easy to do and very relaxing, just like a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

Swap the blocks to recreate the desired island and it will compose the archipelago.

There is no time limit, logic challenges, or resources to manage, so you can calmly just focus on the core mechanics while listening to a soothing soundtrack.
[list]
[*] Click on two blocks to swap them,
[*] Turn the camera around the island;
[*] Zoom in and out to see details or the big picture;
[*] Preview the expected arrangement.
[/list]
As you progress building the islands, see your archipelago expand and evolve in the background.
With clear skies, fresh air, and crystal clear water, among animals and listening to the sounds of nature.


Play it now!

Follow us on Steam and keep up-to-date with our releases!
